issues.quote: Félix laughed, as he does when he is embarrassed, and said that his father's silver watch had run badly for ten years and that he would not let anyone touch it, not even his uncle.
issues.fact: O1 gives only that Félix's watch (the one checked at nine) showed twenty minutes to nine. It does not say whether that was the silver watch.
issues.misreading: Placed right after the 8:40 reading, the silver watch's history of running badly and Félix's refusal to let anyone touch it could lead a solver to think the silver watch is the one that read twenty minutes to nine, or that the 8:40 reading is unreliable. The sheet does not link the two watches.
